scientific_question: Can an oracle-free mechanism-preserving response-frame equivalence posterior recover materially more of the privileged local-frame signal than uniform candidate marginalization, without true-location supervision or main-model retraining?

candidate_and_calibration_contract.candidate_set: exactly the frozen Step-14 latent plausible_candidates rule
candidate_and_calibration_contract.frame_calibration: exactly the frozen finite-shot plus/minus X/Y/Z calibration rule
candidate_and_calibration_contract.candidate_feature: exactly the frozen 24-d finite-shot canonical feature
candidate_and_calibration_contract.candidate_mechanism_profile_score: exactly the frozen finite-shot signed-amplitude profile Gaussian log-likelihood

equivalence_aware_inference.candidate_network: reproduce the frozen shared 24->64->3 latent MIL candidate network trained with the original uniform log-mean-exp bag objective; equivalence awareness enters only after candidate logits are formed

pairwise_similarity.axis_normalization: L2-normalize each finite-shot X/Y/Z response column independently
pairwise_similarity.matrix: absolute cosine matrix between the three normalized axes of candidate i and candidate j
pairwise_similarity.identity_assignment_margin: mean diagonal absolute cosine minus best non-identity axis-permutation mean absolute cosine
pairwise_similarity.kernel: exp(-(1-minimum_same_axis_abs_cosine)/tau) when the mechanism-preserving gate is satisfied; zero otherwise; diagonal forced to one

equivalence_aware_inference.candidate_frame_evidence: log-mean-exp over the three frozen finite-shot candidate-mechanism profile log-likelihoods
equivalence_aware_inference.kernel_density: sum of pairwise equivalence-kernel weights from an anchor to all valid candidates
equivalence_aware_inference.equivalence_smoothed_mechanism_logits: kernel-weighted log-mean-exp of learned candidate mechanism logits within each anchor neighborhood
equivalence_aware_inference.final_mechanism_logits: log-sum-exp of equivalence-smoothed mechanism logits under the frame posterior

fit_only_hyperparameter_selection.fold_rule: first eight bytes of SHA256(family_id) interpreted as unsigned integer mod 3
objective_order: higher pooled cross-fitted mechanism balanced accuracy
higher pooled cross-fitted minimum mechanism recall
smaller absolute log-ratio of tau to 0.05
smaller absolute log-ratio of frame_temperature to 1.0

fresh_holdout_precommitment.generator_contract: same Step-14 cross-motif grammar, strengths, shots, finite-shot sampling, model-blind identifiability admission, and signature exclusions; new seed namespace and family identifiers only

confirmatory_statistics_and_support_gate.raw_baseline: fit-only raw small probe evaluated on the same fresh holdout
confirmatory_statistics_and_support_gate.privileged_reference: true-location exact local-frame small probe evaluated analysis-only after oracle-free predictions are frozen
